staff_messenger_id_check.name: staff_messenger_id_check
staff_messenger_id_check.value: "staff"."tg_user_id" is not null or "staff"."max_user_id" is not null

vin_requests_photos_check.name: vin_requests_photos_check
vin_requests_photos_check.value: case when jsonb_typeof("vin_requests"."photos") = 'array' then jsonb_array_length("vin_requests"."photos") <= 3 else false end

supplier_returns_refunded_check.name: supplier_returns_refunded_check
supplier_returns_refunded_check.value: "supplier_returns"."status"::text <> 'refunded' or ("supplier_returns"."refunded_at" is not null and "supplier_returns"."amount_received_kop" is not null)

claims_decision_text_check.name: claims_decision_text_check
claims_decision_text_check.value: "claims"."decision" is null or ("claims"."decided_at" is not null and coalesce(length(btrim("claims"."decision_text")), 0) between 1 and 2000)

claims_override_reason_check.name: claims_override_reason_check
claims_override_reason_check.value: "claims"."override_reason" is null or ("claims"."decision" is not null and "claims"."decision" = 'refund' and length(btrim("claims"."override_reason")) > 0)

claims_replacement_ordered_check.name: claims_replacement_ordered_check
claims_replacement_ordered_check.value: "claims"."replacement_ordered_at" is null or ("claims"."decision" = 'replace' and "claims"."replacement_supplier_order_id" is not null)

claims_photos_check.name: claims_photos_check
claims_photos_check.value: case when jsonb_typeof("claims"."photos") = 'array' then jsonb_array_length("claims"."photos") <= 3 else false end

notifications_recipient_check.name: notifications_recipient_check
notifications_recipient_check.value: "notifications"."user_id" is not null or "notifications"."staff_id" is not null or "notifications"."chat_id" is not null

price_benchmarks_our_snapshot_check.name: price_benchmarks_our_snapshot_check
price_benchmarks_our_snapshot_check.value: ("price_benchmarks"."our_supplier_kop" is null and "price_benchmarks"."our_price_kop" is null and "price_benchmarks"."our_is_local" is null and "price_benchmarks"."our_eta_days" is null) or ("price_benchmarks"."our_supplier_kop" is not null and "price_benchmarks"."our_price_kop" is not null and "price_benchmarks"."our_is_local" is not null and "price_benchmarks"."our_eta_days" is not null and "price_benchmarks"."our_supplier_kop" > 0 and "price_benchmarks"."our_price_kop" > 0 and "price_benchmarks"."our_eta_days" >= 0)

fit_checks_comment_check.name: fit_checks_comment_check
fit_checks_comment_check.value: "fit_checks"."comment" is null or length("fit_checks"."comment") between 1 and 200

fit_checks_answer_check.name: fit_checks_answer_check
fit_checks_answer_check.value: ("fit_checks"."answered_at" is not null) = ("fit_checks"."status" in ('fits', 'analog', 'not_fit', 'call_needed')) and ("fit_checks"."answered_by" is null or "fit_checks"."answered_at" is not null)

fit_checks_analog_check.name: fit_checks_analog_check
fit_checks_analog_check.value: ("fit_checks"."status" = 'analog') = ("fit_checks"."analog_brand" is not null) and ("fit_checks"."analog_brand" is null) = ("fit_checks"."analog_article" is null) and ("fit_checks"."analog_brand" is null) = ("fit_checks"."analog_name" is null) and ("fit_checks"."analog_brand" is null) = ("fit_checks"."analog_offer" is null)

kit_lines_role_check.name: kit_lines_role_check
kit_lines_role_check.value: "kit_lines"."role" is null or length(btrim("kit_lines"."role")) between 1 and 60

kits_note_check.name: kits_note_check
kits_note_check.value: "kits"."note" is null or length("kits"."note") between 1 and 300

user_vehicles_engine_check.name: user_vehicles_engine_check
user_vehicles_engine_check.value: "user_vehicles"."engine" is null or length(btrim("user_vehicles"."engine")) between 1 and 40
